topic: Universal Memory Protocol: A Shared Format for AI Agent Memory

key_points: UMP is a transport-neutral memory protocol for AI agents: a small set of negotiated operations over a portable, signed, bi-temporal record format.
Frames UMP as 'the third interoperability layer' alongside MCP (tools) and A2A (coordination).
Problem: every harness (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT, OSS long-tail) reinvents memory privately and non-portably; user preferences and project knowledge are trapped in whichever tool learned them.

Design in one line: negotiated operations over a portable, signed, bi-temporal record; any harness can speak it over MCP, HTTP, or files; any store can serve it; the user owns and can export the result.
Key primitives: recall, remember, get, revise, forget, capabilities; Memory Record kinds, scope, bi-temporal time, lifecycle hints, relations, provenance, consent, integrity.
UMP composes with the agent stack: MCP is its primary binding (rides MCP instead of defining new transport); A2A moves work while UMP is the shared memory they carry.
Reuses W3C PROV/DID for provenance & identity, OAuth 2.0 for capability tokens.

Distinguishes three existing memory layers UMP is NOT: runtime tool-surfaces (Mem0/OpenMemory, Letta blocks - proprietary verbs per product), storage/retrieval engines (temporal KGs, tiered memory OSes), and interchange formats (PAM, MIF, conversation-backup - static files with no runtime/access control).
UMP's lane = transport-neutral, access-controlled memory protocol with an MCP binding.
Notes a separate 'Open Memory Protocol' project that handles AI conversation backup/portability of raw chat transcripts - a different layer that could interoperate.
Self-described 'Universal memory layer for AI Agents' - the leading open-source agent memory library.
~63.9k GitHub stars, ~7.5k forks (high adoption signal for agent memory).
Enhances assistants/agents with an intelligent memory layer for personalized AI interactions; remembers user preferences and adapts to individual needs.
Use cases across verticals: healthcare (patient preferences), productivity & gaming (adaptive workflows), personalized chat.
Offers OSS SDK + self-hosted stack + Mem0 Platform; publishes an open memory-benchmarks repo; scores 92.5 on LoCoMo (+21 points) benchmark.
UMP is designed for incremental adoption: publish a *.ump.json export the same day; wire the MCP profile in an afternoon; implement the full signed, access-controlled runtime when ready.
Strategy: 'value with one vendor, day one' - Recall as the first production engine adapter.
Includes deliverables checklist, governance, sequencing, remaining open decisions.
Reference implementation ships record format, server ops, MCP/HTTP/file bindings, conformance runner, and store adapters.

Use it now from any MCP host; includes the ump CLI, install & test, cross-vendor round-trip, reference server, persistent memory server, importing existing memory files, picking a store, wiring the MCP binding into an agent.
Reference implementation (@universalmemoryprotocol/core) ships the UMP record format, server ops, MCP/HTTP/file bindings, conformance runner, and store adapters.
Conformance levels: default persistent server is L2 until capability-token enforcement is enabled at the binding boundary.

stats.fact: mem0, the leading open-source 'universal memory layer for AI agents', has ~63,900 GitHub stars and ~7,500 forks.
UMP positions itself as the third interoperability layer beside MCP (Model Context Protocol for tools) and A2A (Agent2Agent for coordination).
MCP standardized how agents call tools and read resources; A2A standardized how agents discover and invoke one another; UMP standardizes portable knowledge across sessions, agents, and vendors.
The UMP specification (v0.1) defines a minimal surface of six core operations (capabilities, recall, remember, get, revise, forget) and one memory record type, bound by five design constraints.
UMP record features include bi-temporal time (validity vs. assertion time) as the staleness fix, provenance (reusing W3C PROV/DID), consent, integrity/signing, and injection-resistant rehydration.
mem0 reports a LoCoMo (long-context memory) benchmark score of 92.5, +21 points over baseline.

angles: The 'third interoperability layer' framing: MCP did tools, A2A did coordination, UMP does memory - a clean mental model for developers.
Memory portability and user ownership: your preferences, corrections, and project knowledge should follow you across Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT - not be trapped in one vendor.
The bi-temporal memory design as 'the staleness fix': distinguishing when a fact is true from when it was asserted solves stale memory.
Injection-resistant rehydration as a security-first memory design - protecting against prompt-injection via memory.
Incremental adoption path: export a *.ump.md the same day, wire the MCP binding in an afternoon, full signed runtime later - lowering the barrier to adoption.
The ecosystem comparison: runtime tool-surfaces (mem0, Letta), storage engines (temporal KGs), interchange formats (PAM, MIF, conversation-backup) - vs UMP's transport/access-controlled lane.
